subject: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, ravenbank-sec@ravenbank.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot

Team —

Ravenbank is kicking off a 6-week pilot (proof-of-concept) with our EU region requirement: all inference for their pilot must be processed in EU-only infrastructure with NO automatic fallback to other regions or model variants. Their legal and security teams flagged data residency and strict audit controls; they will not accept any cross-region processing.

Ask: can Product + Ops approve a short-lived no-fallback / region-lock policy for the pilot window (April 15 — May 31)? Key constraints they require are:
- EU-only serving (no cross-region fallback)
- Forced model selection: pinned to rdl-v2-eu (quantized) for consistency
- KV cache ephemeral (no persistence beyond session)
- Cryptographic attestation of key IDs (they will provide KMS details)

Attached is the Ravenbank MAAP (security summary) and a preliminary timeline. I need an initial go/no-go by EOD Wed so we can get legal and sales to draft the addendum.

Attachment: Ravenbank_MAAP.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot

Naomi —

Thanks for the heads up and attachment. Ops concerns up front:
- No-fallback increases outage blast radius; we need a clear SLO adjustment and rollback runbook.
- Forcing rdl-v2-eu removes multi-variant fallbacks used to mitigate kernel regressions; we'll need a compatibility verification window (24–48 hrs) before the pilot start.
- Capacity: do we have reserved Dedicated slots in eu-west-1 for the requested qps during peak? If not, we'll need to provision or throttle.

Can we get Ravenbank to share expected qps profile (p50/p95 seq lengths) and KMS key ID? If they can host their key in an EU KMS and we can attest, that lowers the risk.

I've attached a quick ops-impact csv with estimated cost and capacity delta assuming a strict no-fallback config.

Attachment: ops-impact.csv (csv)

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Platform Operations
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot

Agree with Grace's operational concerns. From Product/Infra side:
- Implementation approach: implement a region-lock flag at the routing layer that prevents cross-region reroutes. At the model layer, support a "pin_model" attribute per-tenant. Both are small config additions but require 3–5 business days plus a staging verification.
- Rollout plan: feature flag behind canary; enable for Ravenbank only in staging, run a 48-hr load test, then enable in prod at 10% traffic for 12 hours, then 100% if all metrics are green.
- Fallback alternatives: suggest we keep an emergency fallback path (manual) that requires two-person authorization from Ops + Product for cross-region reroute in case of catastrophic outage. That preserves safety while meeting their automated no-fallback requirement.

We also need legal to sign off on SLA changes and credits for increased risk. If Ravenbank provides the EU KMS key IDs and SOC2 summary, we can produce a short attestation.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Product Infrastructure
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@ravenbank.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ravenbank-sec@ravenbank.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot

Hi Naomi / Redwood team —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. A few clarifications from Ravenbank security:
- We will only accept an automated policy that guarantees EU-only processing. A manual, auditable emergency bypass is acceptable but must be logged and require explicit approvals recorded in the audit trail.
- We will provide the KMS key IDs for our EU tenant (aws:kms:eu-west-1:987654321:key/xxxxxxxx). We need proof that keys never leave EU regions and that encrypted payloads are only decrypted in EU compute.
- SOC2: attaching a redacted pointer to our SOC2 report and a short checklist of controls you'd need to confirm.

Link: https://ravenbank.share/soc2/report-2027
Attachment: ravenbank-soc2-summary.txt (txt)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce a per-request audit field that flags "region-locked=true" and includes the KMS key ID? That will be part of our acceptance criteria.

—Sarah
Sarah Jones
Head of Security, Ravenbank
sarah.jones@ravenbank.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@ravenbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai, sales-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only / no-fallback routing for Ravenbank pilot

Thanks everyone — this is actionable. Summary of next steps and owners:
1) Product/Infra (Marcus) — implement region-lock + pin_model flag in a tenant-scoped feature flag. Provide staging plan and ETA (target: feature-ready by Apr 13, canary on Apr 14).
2) Ops (Grace) — validate capacity & run the 48-hr compatibility tests; prepare rollback runbook and emergency bypass procedure (2-person auth).
3) Security (Ravenbank) — provide KMS key IDs and SOC2 pointer (Sarah).
4) Legal/Sales — draft pilot addendum and SLA adjustments (cc'd).

Acceptance criteria for Ravenbank: per-request audit field including region-locked=true and kms_key_id; no automated cross-region fallback during pilot. Manual emergency bypass allowed but must be recorded in audit logs with approver IDs and timestamp.

Irene, can you help coordinate the legal addendum language and ensure we capture the emergency bypass signoff mechanics?

I'll keep Ravenbank updated and will schedule a quick alignment call tomorrow once we have the staging dates.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
